newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Keppel, FELS sell stake in drilling firm.
newsitem.headline: Keppel, FELS sell stake in drilling firm.

text.p: Keppel Corp Ltd said on Wednesday it had signed a letter of intent together with Far East Levingston Shipbuilding Ltd, to sell their 50 percent stake in Petrodril Holdings Inc.
The stake, comprising both ordinary and preferential shares, would be sold to Norwegian drilling contractor Smedvig ASA for US$19.67 million in cash, Keppel said in a statement.
The transaction is expected to be completed by mid-March and will have no material impact on Keppel's earnings.
The transaction will result in a gain of about Singapore $5.5 million or 2.6 cents per share for Far East Livingston.
Keppel said it had decided to divest its interest in Petrodril after the company's other shareholder, Rogets Holdings Inc, decided to sell its stake.
